messages:
alex: heads-up — I can repro a console card showing a project id from a different org when rapidly switching projects in the left rail. not full data leak (no secrets) but the card title/metric shows wrong project.
sasha: ugh. steps?
alex: 1) open insights rail, 2) quick-switch project A -> project B -> project A within ~1s, 3) click the summary card. seen on prod and staging.
alex: looking at logs, the card rendering path is pulling `X-Project-Context` from a cached header blob rather than the request-scoped context. here's the small snippet I saw in the proxy logs:
```
INFO ReusedHeaderBlob id=hdr-abc user=alex cached_for=5s header={X-Project-Context: 7890}
INFO RenderCard project=1234 user=alex route=/api/console/card/summary
```
maria: sounds like cache key is just user id or route. we should be including project id + user + route in the cache key. otherwise rapid switching interleaves responses.
jonathan: is this the prefetch/prefill path from the nav quickswitch? I remember we added a small in-memory bundle to accelerate rails.
kevin: yes, QuickPrefetchService uses a shared LRU per-instance. current key: `userId:route`. missing projectId — I can repro locally if I mock two projects and hammer switch.
sasha: immediate mitigation: disable quick-prefetch for rails on the frontend (feature flag: quick_prefetch_rails). that will stop cross-project renderings while we patch.
alex: can someone flip the flag? it's part of the rollout. @deploy-bot did we push the flag toggles earlier today?
deploy-bot: rollouts: feature quick_prefetch_rails = true -> toggled at 2026-03-21T10:12:00Z by rollout-service
maria: ok I'll schedule a quick rollback of that flag for canary and prod. also propose a short-term server-side check: when rendering card, assert `request.projectId == cachedHeader.projectId` and drop cache if mismatch. cheap guard.
jonathan: agreed. long term: change cache key to include `projectId` and add unit tests + fuzz test for rapid-switch timing.
kevin: I'll open a PR for the cache-key fix and the guard. unit tests + integration repro script included.
alex: perfect. I'll own the rollback coordination and alert CS to expect transient missing prefetch perf.
sasha: assign to kevin for PR, maria for flag rollback, alex to coordinate comms. ETA: rollback in 15m, PR by EOD, canary test 1 hour after PR.
alex: thanks everyone. leaving logs and repro in the github thread: https://git.redwood/s/console-card-leak-1745009999 (notes + quick script)
maria: ping me when rollback is done, I'll watch telemetry for mis-attribution spikes.
kevin: starting work now. reproducer script attached in PR.
alex: :thumbsup:
